resources.string: Remove connected profiles and active sessions first. Deletion is blocked during installation, management, or legacy adoption, or when the runtime cannot be verified stopped.
Delete environment %1$s and its distribution image, install cache, packages, home and settings permanently? Existing /workspace and shared directories are kept.
Delete environment %1$s? Once the VM is confirmed stopped, permanently delete its distribution image, packages, home, settings, persistent state and file copies. Host shared directories are kept.
Manage execution environment names, storage, installation, and runtime state.
ARM64 PRoot engine · no additional Android permissions
The PRoot engine does not support this device architecture.
Custom Linux ARM64 VMs require AVF support and MANAGE_VIRTUAL_MACHINE and USE_CUSTOM_VIRTUAL_MACHINE permissions.
Delete the distribution image and its packages/files permanently. Home and work folders are kept by default. The environment and profiles remain for reinstallation.
Permanently delete the distribution image and VM home/packages/settings. The environment, profiles and shared-directory files remain for reinstallation.
Removal is blocked while sessions or installation/management tasks are active, or runtime safety cannot be verified.
